figurative_meaning_en: To look with a sharp or scrutinizing gaze
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আমাকে ঠাওর করে দেখল, যেন কোনো সন্দেহ আছে।
প্রথমে ঠাওর না করে কেনে নিলে?
example_sentences_in_english: He gave me a scrutinizing look, as if he had some suspicion.
Why did you buy it without giving it a once-over first?
note: Variants like 'ঠাহর করা' are regional pronunciations in Bengali dialects.
